translations.web: that the man slayer who kills any person accidentally or unintentionally may flee there. They shall be to you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.
translations.bsb: so that anyone who kills another unintentionally or accidentally may flee there. These will be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
translations.kjv: That the slayer that killeth any person unawares and unwittingly may flee thither: and they shall be your refuge from the avenger of blood.
translations.asv: that the manslayer that killeth any person unwittingly and unawares may flee thither: and they shall be unto you for a refuge from the avenger of blood.
